hook: Yangqing Jia was still a PhD student at UC Berkeley when he built Caffe, one of the first deep learning frameworks to open source its full code and model zoo, and it became a standard tool for computer vision research for several years. He carried that pattern through a string of AI infrastructure roles, co-creating Google's Inception architecture at Google Brain, building Facebook's internal AI platform and co-creating Caffe2 and ONNX there, then running Alibaba Cloud's computing platform and its DAMO Academy systems lab. He founded Lepton AI in 2023, sold it to NVIDIA in 2025, left NVIDIA in mid-2026 over the company's decision not to open source the platform, and that July launched Intent Lab, an autonomous software engineering startup, with several former Lepton AI colleagues.
name: Yangqing Jia

timeline.event: Publishes Caffe as a UC Berkeley PhD project advised by Trevor Darrell
timeline.impact: Introduces one of the first fully open-source deep learning frameworks

timeline.event: Joins Google Brain as a Research Scientist, co-creating the Inception (GoogLeNet) architecture and contributing to early TensorFlow development
timeline.impact: Extends his open frameworks work into one of the winning architectures of the 2014 ImageNet competition

timeline.event: Becomes Director of AI Infrastructure at Facebook, building the company's general-purpose AI platform and co-creating Caffe2 and ONNX
timeline.impact: Scales deep learning infrastructure to support Facebook's ranking, vision, NLP, and AR systems

timeline.event: Leaves Facebook in March and moves to Alibaba as Vice President of Alibaba Cloud's Computing Platform, also leading the DAMO Academy System AI Lab
timeline.impact: Takes his infrastructure and open-source experience into China's largest cloud provider

timeline.event: Founds Lepton AI, a GPU cloud and inference startup
timeline.impact: Returns to founding after a career spent inside larger organizations

timeline.event: Lepton AI is acquired by NVIDIA in April, reported at roughly $700 million, and Jia becomes a Vice President at NVIDIA
timeline.impact: Brings his GPU cloud platform inside NVIDIA's own infrastructure business

timeline.event: Leaves NVIDIA and launches Intent Lab in July with former Lepton AI colleagues including Junjie Bai, after NVIDIA declined to open source the Lepton platform
timeline.impact: Returns to an independent, open-source-oriented venture focused on autonomous software engineering

quick_facts: Founder and CEO of Intent Lab, launched in July 2026
Created Caffe as a UC Berkeley PhD student advised by Trevor Darrell, publishing the framework in 2014
Co-created Google's Inception (GoogLeNet) architecture as a Research Scientist at Google Brain
Built Facebook's general-purpose AI infrastructure platform as Director of AI Infrastructure, and co-created Caffe2 and ONNX there
Later led Alibaba Cloud's Computing Platform as Vice President and ran the System AI Lab at Alibaba's DAMO Academy
Founded Lepton AI in 2023, sold it to NVIDIA for a reported approximately $700 million in 2025, then left NVIDIA in 2026

achievements.title: Created Caffe
achievements.impact: Built one of the first fully open-source deep learning frameworks as a Berkeley PhD project, described in the 2014 paper Caffe: Convolutional Architecture for Fast Feature Embedding, and it became a standard computer vision research tool before merging into PyTorch.

achievements.title: Co-created Inception/GoogLeNet
achievements.impact: Helped build the architecture that won the 2014 ImageNet competition while a Research Scientist at Google Brain, and contributed to early TensorFlow development.

achievements.title: Built Facebook's AI infrastructure and co-created Caffe2 and ONNX
achievements.impact: As Director of AI Infrastructure at Facebook, built the platform supporting the company's ranking, computer vision, NLP, speech, and augmented reality systems, and co-created Caffe2 and the ONNX model interchange standard.

achievements.title: Founded and sold Lepton AI
achievements.impact: Founded the GPU cloud and inference startup in 2023 and sold it to NVIDIA in a deal reported at roughly $700 million in 2025, per TechNode's reporting.
